title: LEBRE research record — v0.53
description:
Research record of LEBRE (Lifecycle-governed Evidence-Based Resource Evolution), an online one-step-ahead forecaster for time series with inputs, at a fixed cost per step. Its structural core accepts each structural change (adding, removing, swapping or refining the response to a whole input) by an anytime-valid sequential test (e-process) of predictive improvement, within an online multiple-testing procedure. Layer M1 adds a precision expert combined with the core by AdaHedge; layer M2 starts the forecast from a declared trivial reference (zero, persistence or seasonal naive) and combines two paths by an (A,B)-Prod.

Version v0.53 was promoted on 2026-10-09 by a pre-registered rule: on 104 series reserved before any v0.53 code (basins, buildings, solar and wind plants, electric load, FX), its mean squared error was 0.955 of the core's (95% CI 0.951-0.960), with no harm in any family. This archive contains the Python reference implementation, a C99 port of the core with firmware and scripts for a simulated Cortex-M4F microcontroller (Renode), experiment scripts, pre-registrations, result tables, reports, frozen versions with SHA-256 manifests (v0.1, v0.51, v0.52, v0.53), the self-contained v0.53 specification (revision 1, English and Portuguese) and scripts to verify integrity and reproduce results. Development and validations of M1 and M2 are in the public LEBRE Lab (https://github.com/Iquitim/lebre-lab). Raw third-party data, per-series prediction arrays and toolchains are not included; they are listed with SHA-256 in docs/research/ARTIFACTS_MANIFEST.tsv.

Scope and limits. One-step forecasting; the gain of v0.53 came from basins and FX, with no gain in solar, wind and load; about twice the cost of the core (median 919 operations per step); no formal error guarantee in the original scale for M1 and M2; microcontroller costs only for the core and from a simulator; the core's testing mechanism did not improve accuracy over an all-inputs-on ablation; no component is original. See the specification, section 22.
